paper.title_en: Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) optimization of residual correction of $α$-decay energy based on Weizsacker-Skyrme 4 model
paper.abstract_en: A physics-guided hybrid framework combining the Weizsacker-Skyrme-4 (WS4) macroscopic-microscopic mass model with the Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) is developed to improve the accuracy of alpha-decay energy predictions for superheavy nuclei. TabPFN learns the residuals between experimental data and WS4 predictions using nuclear-structure features. Through ablation studies of 18 feature combinations, the optimal feature set is identified, reducing the overall root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.2743 to 0.1442 MeV, an improvement of 47.43%. The corrected model improves prediction accuracy across all four odd-even nuclear configurations while preserving shell effects and odd-even staggering patterns along the Po, Rn, and U isotopic chains. The framework is further applied to predict decay energy values for experimentally unmeasured nuclei along the Z = 118-120 isotopic chains. The extrapolated results retain the overall trends of WS4 and exhibit signatures associated with the predicted neutron shell closure at N = 184. These findings highlight the potential of physics-guided residual learning for predicting the decay properties of superheavy nuclei.
